# Spaiky

> Spaiky is a gamified mobile app that teaches AI literacy in five-minute lessons. It works like Duolingo, but for artificial intelligence: short interactive levels, XP, streaks, and trophies. The app is designed for non-technical learners aged 18 to 30 who want to understand AI prompting, large language models, and machine learning without jargon.

## What Spaiky teaches

- AI prompting and prompt engineering
- How large language models (LLMs) work
- Practical use of ChatGPT and other AI tools
- Machine learning fundamentals (no math required)
- Responsible and effective AI usage

## Key facts

- Platform: Android (live on Google Play), iPhone coming soon
- Pricing: Free to start
- Lesson length: ~5 minutes
- Target audience: Beginners, no tech background needed
- Number of lessons: 80+
- Learners: 1,200+
- Company: Spaik Solutions
- Contact: contact@spaiky.app

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://spaiky.app/): Main landing page with overview, features, and waitlist signup
- [Privacy Policy](https://spaiky.app/privacy): How we collect, use, and protect user data
- [Delete Account](https://spaiky.app/delete-account): How users can request deletion of their account and data

## How to access Spaiky

- Android users can download the app directly from Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spaiky.app
- iPhone users can join the waitlist on the homepage to be notified when the iOS version launches

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Spaiky?**
Spaiky is a mobile app that teaches AI in short, gamified lessons. Think Duolingo, but for AI literacy.

**Who is Spaiky for?**
Anyone aged 18 to 30 who wants to learn about AI without a technical background. No coding or math required.

**Is Spaiky free?**
Yes, Spaiky is free to start.

**How long are the lessons?**
About 5 minutes each. They're designed to fit into a coffee break or commute.

**What does Spaiky teach?**
AI prompting, how large language models work, practical use of ChatGPT, and machine learning fundamentals.

**Is Spaiky available on iPhone?**
Not yet. The iOS version is coming soon. iPhone users can join the waitlist on the homepage.

**Is Spaiky available on Android?**
Yes, Spaiky is live on Google Play.

**Who makes Spaiky?**
Spaiky is developed by Spaik Solutions.
